title: Pick-and-Place Scenario
description: A single runnable MuJoCo pick-and-place episode: robot config, scene objects/fixtures, task definition, and success criteria.

seed.description: RNG seed for any 'randomize' blocks in this file. Omit for a fixed, non-randomized scenario.

model.description: Name of the robot asset under robot/. Only kr35_r1840_3_hw exists today.

base_pose.description: Robot base mounting pose in world frame. Defaults to origin.

home_joint_positions.description: Starting joint angles (rad), one per joint_1..joint_6. Defaults to all zeros.

end_effector.description: Only suction is modeled today; kept as a field for future grippers.

max_payload_kg.description: If the picked object's mass exceeds this, the runner reports a suction-overload failure instead of engaging the weld.

engage_max_distance_m.description: Max gap between suction_site and the nearest object surface point for a seal to be considered formed.

engage_max_misalignment_deg.description: Max angle between the cup's approach axis and the local contact normal for a seal to form.

ground_friction.description: [sliding, torsional, rolling] friction coefficients for the ground plane.

fixtures.description: Static, non-graspable scene geometry (tables, bins, trays). Never randomized.

objects.description: Dynamic (free-jointed) objects, at least one of which is normally the pick target.

object_id.description: Must match an id in scene.objects.

grasp_point.description: Grasp point in the object's local frame. Defaults to the object's top-center face.

approach_axis.description: Unit vector (world frame) the suction cup approaches the grasp point along. Default: straight down.

target_fixture_id.description: Alternative to target_pose: place centered on top of this fixture's surface.

approach_height_m.description: Clearance height used for the pre-pick/pre-place hover waypoints and transit.

joint_speed_scale.description: Fraction of each joint's max velocity used for waypoint interpolation.

settle_time_s.description: Object must stay within tolerance and near-zero velocity for this long, continuously, to count as placed.

max_sim_time_s.description: Episode timeout; exceeding it without success is a failure.

forbidden_contacts.description: Optional list of fixture/object ids the picked object must not touch during transit (e.g. bin walls).

randomize_range.description: Uniform-random override for a pose field, sampled with the scenario's top-level seed.

yaw_range_deg.description: [min,max] yaw-only randomization (objects are assumed to rest flat).

size.description: MuJoCo half-extent convention: box=[hx,hy,hz], cylinder=[radius,half_height], sphere=[radius].

friction.description: [sliding, torsional, rolling], defaults to MuJoCo defaults if omitted.

graspable.description: Whether the runner should register a candidate suction weld for this object.
